title: FRAMES Dataset Build and Multi-Hop Evaluation Process

nodes.label:
Multi-Document Reasoning Objective
Evaluate RAG and long-context LLMs on complex multi-hop QA
Require factual synthesis across 2 to 15 distinct Wikipedia articles

Automated LLM Synthesis Pilot
Prompt Gemini 1.5 Pro to generate multi-article QA pairs
Attempt automated question generation from Wikipedia clusters

Pilot Feasibility & Factuality Gate
Audit synthetic questions for hallucination and reasoning depth
Branch on synthetic quality vs expert human authoring

Discard Synthetic Pipeline
Observe >30% hallucination rate in model-generated questions
Reject automated generation in favor of human expert authoring

Standardized Expert Task Guidelines
Enforce multi-step reasoning requiring 2-15 Wikipedia sources
Mandate source URL recording and unambiguous factual answers

Human Expert Question Authoring
Trained researchers craft challenging multi-hop questions
Categorize across 5 reasoning types (Numerical, Temporal, Tabular, etc.)

Three-Month Longitudinal Audit
Re-annotate entire dataset 3 months after creation
Filter out perishable temporal facts and ambiguous answers

Factuality & Non-Guessability Gate
Verify multi-source dependency and eliminate binary choices
Filter out items answerable from single documents

Ambiguous & Outdated Question Filter
Discard items failing temporal re-annotation or source checks
Remove binary yes/no guessing items

824 Verified FRAMES Benchmark Instances
Gold-standard multi-hop questions requiring 2-15 articles
Frozen test suite on Hugging Face google/frames-benchmark

Multi-Condition RAG & Long-Context Evaluation
Compare Naive LLM, BM25 retrieval (k=5 to 100 docs), and Oracle context
Execute multi-step inference prompting and citation extraction

Tri-Axial Performance Evaluation
Measure retrieval recall, reasoning accuracy, and factuality
Comprehensive end-to-end RAG benchmark report
